tasks.title: All migrations reviewed
tasks.evidence: Reconciliation executed 14 Sep 2026. All 126 applied-without-file versions accounted for: 93 non-executing marker files committed under supabase/migrations/<version>_reconciliation_marker.sql (comment-only, verified by the parity checker), 33 catalogue-DML versions formally excluded via supabase/migrations/.excluded-versions under the written policy in docs/MIGRATION_RECONCILIATION.md. No historical DDL or DML was replayed and no SQL was invented. Parity tooling honours the exclusion registry and rejects malformed entries, excluded-but-committed versions and any marker containing executable SQL. Local parity passes: 375 files, 93 markers comment-only, 33 excluded. 12 unit tests green. EXTERNAL VERIFICATION BLOCKER: the live remote diff still cannot run because SUPABASE_DB_URL is absent from repository secrets — this is recorded, not assumed to pass.
